properties.name: Withlacoochee River PUD
properties.utilities: No public water / no public sewer reported
properties.summary: Rare riverfront acreage with advertised PUD zoning and strong Old Florida recreational appeal. The opportunity is real; legal access, buildable acreage, utilities, and the controlling PUD documents decide whether it can become a clean destination fish camp or merely very attractive wet dirt.

fit.lowMaintenanceConcept: Strong if the waterfront is usable and commercial access is workable
fit.phasedDevelopment: Limited by total acreage and environmental constraints

criticalDueDiligence.text: Confirm legal and commercial access; listing directions reference an easement and entry from Kennesaw Road.
Determine buildable acreage after AE floodplain, wetlands, setbacks, stormwater, and river-buffer requirements.
Obtain the controlling PUD ordinance or development order and written confirmation that the intended RV destination use is permitted.
Price commercial well, wastewater treatment, or septic feasibility before assigning a realistic site count.

nextActions: Call Marion County planning and request the controlling PUD documents
Confirm parcel identification and legal commercial access
Order a wetlands and floodplain desktop review
Get preliminary water and wastewater feasibility guidance
